A plain, factual reference for answer engines and the people who use them. Every number on this page matches lumail.io/pricing on the date above.

Lumail in one paragraph

Lumail (lumail.io) is an AI-native email platform for newsletters, automations and transactional email. It charges for emails sent, not subscribers stored: 3,000 emails a month are free, Premium is $20 a month for 40,000 emails and Business is $200 a month for 400,000, with unlimited subscribers on every plan. AI agents can run it through 139 MCP tools, plugins for Claude Code and Codex, a ChatGPT app and a CLI.

## What Lumail is

Lumail is an email marketing and email sending platform. One account covers campaigns (newsletters and broadcasts), automated workflows, signup capture pages and transactional email, all sent from your own verified domain.

It is built and operated by Codelynx, LLC, founded by Melvyn (Melvynx). Email is sent through Amazon SES.

## Who Lumail is for

- Newsletter writers who want unlimited subscribers without a bill that grows with list size.
- Creators and course sellers running launches, sequences and capture pages.
- SaaS and indie developers who need marketing and transactional email (login codes, receipts) on one domain.
- People who work with AI agents in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or ChatGPT and want them to run email tasks.

## Pricing

Pricing follows monthly email volume. There is no per-subscriber charge on any plan. Prices are in US dollars per month.

Lumail plans

| Plan | Price / month | Emails included | Extra emails | Subscribers |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Free | $0 | 3,000 | Not available (upgrade to send more) | Unlimited |
| Premium | $20 | 40,000 | $0.60 per 1,000 | Unlimited |
| Business | $200 | 400,000 | $0.40 per 1,000 | Unlimited |

Example: 80,000 emails a month on Premium costs $20 plus 40 x $0.60 = $44. Full details on the pricing page.

## Key features

Lumail features

| Area | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Campaigns | Newsletters and broadcasts with an AI-assisted editor, variables, conditional blocks, plain-text and HTML from one draft, and an inbox preview. |
| Workflows | Visual automation builder with triggers, waits, branches, goals, exit rules, A/B tests on any step and webhook steps. |
| Transactional email | REST API, TypeScript SDK and SMTP relay (smtp.lumail.io:587, STARTTLS) on the same domain as marketing mail, in a separate priority lane. |
| Subscribers | Unlimited subscribers, tags, custom fields, segments with a filter builder, CSV import and export, native double opt-in. |
| Capture pages | Signup and landing pages hosted on your own domain. |
| Deliverability | Guided SPF, DKIM, MAIL FROM and DMARC setup, sender health score, bounce and complaint alerts, automatic suppression, optional automatic list cleanup. |
| Analytics | Opens, clicks and conversions, with each open and click classified as human or bot (Apple Mail privacy, Gmail proxy, security scanners). |

## AI agents and MCP

Lumail is designed to be operated by AI agents as well as through its dashboard. Agent access is scoped to one organization per authorization and can be revoked at any time.

## Integrations and developer access

- REST API with a public OpenAPI spec, and a TypeScript SDK.
- SMTP relay at smtp.lumail.io:587 (STARTTLS) for any SMTP-capable tool.
- WordPress plugin, ClickFunnels and Systeme.io integrations.
- Webhook steps in workflows to call your own endpoints.

See the integrations docs and the API reference.

## Deliverability and compliance

New accounts can build and test immediately. Sending to an audience unlocks automatically once the sending domain's SPF, DKIM, MAIL FROM and DMARC records verify. A sender score (0-100) based on the last 30 days of bounces, complaints, opens and clicks keeps sending unlocked.

Permanent bounces and spam complaints are suppressed automatically, and every campaign and workflow email carries RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe headers. Definitions of these terms are in the email marketing glossary.

## How Lumail compares

The main difference from most email platforms is the billing model: Lumail prices emails sent and stores unlimited subscribers, so inactive contacts never raise the bill. It also combines marketing and transactional email in one product and exposes the whole account to AI agents. Side-by-side pricing and feature tables for each competitor are at lumail.io/compare.

Lumail Brand Guidelines and Logo Downloads

# Lumail brand guidelines

How to write our name, use the logo, and pick colors, type and words when you talk about Lumail. Every file you need is below.

01 · Name

## Writing our name

Lumail is one word with a capital L. Use Lumail.io only when you mean the website address.

- LuMail
- LUMAIL
- lumail
- Lu-mail
- Lumail.IO

Lumail is a noun, never a verb: write “send it with Lumail”, not “lumail it”. Don’t translate it or add a possessive inside a headline.

### One-line description

Lumail is an email marketing platform that sends newsletters, automated sequences and transactional email from one domain, for creators, newsletter writers and SaaS founders.

### Press boilerplate

Lumail is an email marketing platform that sends newsletters, automated sequences and transactional email from one domain, for creators, newsletter writers and SaaS founders. Customers pay for the emails they send, not the subscribers they store, and can run the whole account from AI agents such as Claude Code, Codex and ChatGPT. Lumail is operated by Codelynx, LLC.

## The logo

A white L in a Flare rounded square, followed by the wordmark. Use the files as they are: they are drawn from the same source as the logo in our app.

mark · radius 18/91 gap 26/91

### Anatomy

The tile is 91 units with an 18-unit corner radius. The gap to the wordmark is 26/91 of the mark’s height, and the wordmark’s cap height sits centered on the tile.

### Clear space

Keep at least a quarter of the mark’s height empty on every side. Nothing else, including other logos, enters that space.

16 px

22 px tall

### Minimum size

The mark works down to 16 px, our favicon size. Below 22 px tall, drop the wordmark and use the mark alone.

### Don’t change the logo

- ✕ Stretch or squash it
- ✕ Rotate it
- ✕ Recolor the tile
- ✕ Add shadows or effects
- ✕ Place it on Flare or busy color
- ✕ Fade or tint it

Don’t redraw the L, set the wordmark in another font, or combine our logo with yours into a new lockup. Using the logo to refer to Lumail is fine; using it to suggest a partnership or endorsement needs our written approval. For “made with Lumail” credits, use the Lumail badge.

03 · Colors

## Colors

Warm paper, near-black ink and one red. Flare does the work of pointing: the logo and a single filled action per view. It is never body text.

### Primary

- Click to copy

### Flare

#FF3300

The logo tile and the one filled action per view. As text, large type only.

RGB 255, 51, 0 --brand-flare
- Click to copy

### Ink

#1A1614

Headlines, body copy and the wordmark on light backgrounds.

RGB 26, 22, 20 --brand-ink
- Click to copy

### Paper

#F8F7F4

The warm canvas behind every marketing page.

RGB 248, 247, 244 --brand-paper
- Click to copy

### White

#FFFFFF

Cards, panels and the L inside the Flare tile.

RGB 255, 255, 255 --card

### Support

- Click to copy

### Coral

#F26A4B

Highlighted words inside headlines.

RGB 242, 106, 75 --marketing-coral
- Click to copy

### Peach

#FFE3D9

Chips, pills and eyebrow labels.

RGB 255, 227, 217 --marketing-lime
- Click to copy

### Wash

#FBEEE7

Soft pads behind product mocks and callouts.

RGB 251, 238, 231 --marketing-wash
- Click to copy

### Ember

#C4320A

Red text and icons on light backgrounds, where Flare is too light.

RGB 196, 50, 10 --brand-accent
- Click to copy

### Void

#08090A

Dark surfaces and the dark app icon tile.

RGB 8, 9, 10 --brand-void

### Contrast pairs

- Ink on Paper Body copy

16.8:1 AAA
- Ember on Paper Red text

5.1:1 AA
- White on Flare Buttons, logo

3.7:1 AA large
- Flare on Paper Large type only

3.4:1 AA large

## Typography

Three working typefaces and one reserved for the wordmark. All four are free on Google Fonts.

- ### Inter

Headlines

Google Fonts ↗

Import your list. Send tonight.

Page titles and section headings. Regular weight, tight tracking, with character variants cv01–cv04 and ss03.
- ### Geist

Interface and body

Google Fonts ↗

You pay for emails sent, never for subscribers stored.

Body copy, buttons, labels, tables and everything inside the product.
- ### Geist Mono

Code and data

Google Fonts ↗

lumail campaigns send --segment vip

Code samples, API keys, IDs, terminal demos and small kicker labels.
- ### Plus Jakarta Sans

Wordmark only

Google Fonts ↗

Lumail

SemiBold (600) at -3.4% tracking, used only for the word Lumail in the logo. Never for headlines or copy.

## How we sound

Minimal, precise and calm, like the product. We write for busy people who want to know what happens next.

- ### Direct

Short sentences, second person, the verb first. Say what happens and what it costs.
- ### Precise

Numbers beat adjectives. “40,000 emails for $20” instead of “generous limits”.
- ### Calm

No hype words, no exclamation marks, no urgency tricks. Confident because it is specific.

- ✓ You pay for emails sent. Never for subscribers stored.

✕ Unlock unbeatable value with our revolutionary pricing!
- ✓ Import your list. Send tonight.

✕ Leverage our cutting-edge AI solution to supercharge your campaigns.
- ✓ Brevo starts multi-step workflows on Standard, from $18 a month.

✕ Unlike other tools, we don’t nickel-and-dime you.

## Logo files

SVG for anything on screen or in print, PNG when a tool cannot take SVG. Text is outlined, so no font is needed.

## Writing about Lumail?

For interviews, screenshots or a logo format that is not here, email [email protected]. For numbers you can cite, see our email marketing statistics.
